name: asad-md
description: Asad MD — local-first WhatsApp archiver. Records inbox text + voice notes, flags deleted-for-everyone messages, notes view-once events. Self-chat commands for retrieval. Postgres auth + storage for cloud deploys.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/auth-store.js && node --check src/handlers.js && node --check src/media.js && node --check src/commands.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf auth-cache media data node_modules/.cache && echo cleaned

author: Muhammad Asad
